language.unsupported: [Mod Update Checker] Unknown language "{value}", falling back to {fallback}. Available: {options}
help.modupdate: Check whether the server's mods are up to date: summary / check now / list / details / download / install / status / reload config
console.loaded: [Mod Update Checker] loaded, {count} jar(s) found in {directory}
console.no_mods_directory: [Mod Update Checker] no mods directory at {directory}; set "server.mods_directory" in the config if it lives elsewhere
console.interval_enabled: [Mod Update Checker] periodic check every {hours} hour(s)
console.check_scheduled: [Mod Update Checker] checking for mod updates in {seconds} second(s)
console.config_invalid: [Mod Update Checker] config was invalid and has been rebuilt from defaults; the old file is kept as {backup}
console.config_created: [Mod Update Checker] no config file yet — one has been created with the defaults: {path} ({count} option(s))
console.config_completed: [Mod Update Checker] the config file was missing {count} option(s); they have been filled in from the defaults: {names} ({path})
console.config_incomplete: [Mod Update Checker] the config file is missing {count} option(s) and was not updated: {names} ({path})
console.cache_summary: [Mod Update Checker] resolve cache: {records} entr(ies) in {path}
command.permission_denied: Permission denied: this command needs MCDR permission level {level}
command.no_report_yet: No check has run yet. Use !!modupdate check to run one now.
command.check_started: Checking mods for updates in the background; the result will be printed here.
command.check_already_running: A check is already running, please wait for it to finish.
check.finished_clean: [Mod Update Checker] every mod is up to date
check.in_game_header: [Mod Update Checker] {count} mod(s) have a newer build that has not been downloaded
check.in_game_awaiting: already downloaded, waiting to be installed: {count}
report.awaiting_install_hint: (they are in {folder}; run '!!modupdate install <number>' to have the plugin put one in at the next stop, or copy it into mods/ yourself)
report.awaiting_install_found: {count} mod(s) have a newer build downloaded and waiting to go into mods:
download.summary: [Mod Update Checker] downloads: {downloaded} fetched, {existing} already present, {failed} failed, {skipped} skipped — {folder}
download.crashed: [Mod Update Checker] the download stage failed: {error}
download.bad_folder: [Mod Update Checker] downloads are switched on but the folder name is unusable ({reason}): {name}. Nothing was downloaded.
download.reason.no-hash-to-verify: upstream published no hash, so the file cannot be verified
download.reason.declared-too-large: the file is over the download.max_size_mb limit
download.reason.name-conflict: the download folder already holds a different file under that name
check.admin_join_no_report: [Mod Update Checker] no check has completed yet
check.admin_join_reused: (from a check {minutes} minute(s) ago — !!modupdate check to refresh)
report.updates_found: {count} mod(s) have a newer build that has not been downloaded:
report.new_since_last: {count} of those appeared since the last check: {names}
report.blocked_found: {count} mod(s) publish no build for this loader/game version:
report.tally: Checked {total} jar(s): {up_to_date} up to date, {update} with updates not yet downloaded, {awaiting} downloaded and waiting to be installed, {blocked} without a compatible build, {unresolved} unresolved.
report.disabled_header: {count} disabled jar file(s) present and ignored:
matched_by.name: matched by name (approximate)
note.mc_mismatch: built for {range}, but this server runs {server}
note.bundled_jars: bundles {count} nested jar(s); those are not checked separately
note.client_only: is client-only; on a server it does nothing
note.same_version_newer_build: same version number, but the upstream file was republished
note.same_build_other_spelling: same build, named differently: the jar says {local}, the platform says {upstream}
note.no_build_for_game_version: nothing for Minecraft {version}; newest build is {newest}, targeting {targets}
note.matched_by_name: identified by matching the project slug "{slug}", not by file hash — verify before replacing
note.matched_by_manual: the project "{project}" is the one you listed in "project-map.json"
note.manual_map_unknown_project: "project-map.json" points this jar at "{project}", which does not exist on Modrinth — check the spelling
note.cached_unresolved: neither platform knew this jar; skipped without asking again (cached)
note.upstream_failed: the upstream lookup for this mod failed, so no verdict is given
note.search_incomplete: an enabled platform could not be searched, so this jar may in fact exist upstream
note.cannot_compare: version numbers could not be compared, so no verdict is given
note.modrinth_disabled_by_config: Modrinth lookups are disabled in the config
advisory.client_only: {count} client-only mod(s) are installed on this server: {files}
advisory.duplicates: {count} mod id(s) are installed twice — remove the old jar
advisory.unknown_mc_version: the Minecraft version could not be detected, so mods were compared without a game-version filter; set "mc_version" explicitly if the results look wrong
advisory.guessed_mc_version: the Minecraft version was inferred from mod metadata ({version}); set "mc_version" explicitly to be sure
advisory.server_side_unsupported: {count} mod(s) are marked server-unsupported on Modrinth: {files}
advisory.missing_dependencies: {count} declared dependenc(ies) could not be found in mods/: {files} (a dependency bundled inside another jar is reported here too)
console.ignored_mods: [Mod Update Checker] update checks are disabled for {count} mod(s): {names}
console.manual_map_rejected: [Mod Update Checker] "sources.manual_map" must be a file name, not a path; ignoring: {value}
command.help.permission: All of these need MCDR permission level {level} (unrelated to being op in-game)
command.help.entry_summary: show the summary of the last check
command.help.entry_list: list every mod (you can add a status to filter)
command.help.entry_status: show the detected server version, loader and download settings
command.status.manual_map_invalid: ignored (must be a file name, not a path): {value}
console.config_flat_legacy: [Mod Update Checker] {count} option(s) in the config use the old flat names and will not be read (old -> new: {moves}). The file has been rewritten in the new grouped shape; re-apply any value you still want.
report.no_mods: No jars were found in the mods directory.
report.index_title: {count} mod(s). Click [details] for the version change and links:
report.index_truncated: ... {count} more not shown (!!modupdate list <status> to filter)
report.index_hint: Run !!modupdate info <number> for one mod's version change and links.
command.info.usage: Usage: !!modupdate info <number / mod name / mod id> — any of them; the number comes from !!modupdate list.
command.info.unknown: Nothing in the last check matches {value}. Use a number from the list, a mod name, or a jar file name.
command.handle.out_of_range: The last check found {count} mod(s); there is no number {value}. Check the numbers with !!modupdate list.
command.handle.ambiguous: "{value}" matches more than one mod — type more of it, or use the number from the list.
command.help.entry_info: show one mod's details (a number or a name from list)
command.download.usage: usage: {command} download <number / mod name> — either works; the number comes from {command} list.
command.download.plan_header: {count} build(s) about to be fetched from Modrinth:
command.download.started: [Mod Update Checker] fetching {name} {version}; the result is printed here.
command.download.done: [Mod Update Checker] {name} {version} downloaded to {path}. Type {command} to put it into mods/.
command.download.failed: [Mod Update Checker] the download of {name} failed: {reason}
command.download.bad_folder: the download folder is unusable (check 'download.folder_name' in the config), so nothing was fetched.
command.download.no_file: {name} has an update, but upstream published no file to download.
command.download.already: {name} has already been downloaded; there is nothing to fetch. Type {command} to put it into mods/.
command.download.current: {name} is already the newest build ({version}); there is nothing to download.
command.download.no_build: {name} publishes no build for this server, so it cannot be downloaded.
command.download.unresolvable: {name} could not be tied to a Modrinth project ({status}), so it cannot be downloaded.
command.install.usage: usage: {command} install <number / mod name> — either works; the number comes from {command} list.
command.install.plan_header: about to schedule an install (carried out when the server stops):
command.install.plan_swap: replace {old} in mods/ with {new}, keeping the old file as .old
command.install.plan_already_automatic: (install-on-stop is already on, so this would happen anyway; this authorisation just names it)
command.install.not_downloaded: {name} has not been downloaded yet. Type {command} first.
command.install.not_applicable: {name} is '{status}'; there is no downloaded build waiting to be installed.
command.install.no_record: {name} has no download record to install (the download folder may have been emptied).
command.install.approved: [Mod Update Checker] authorised: {name} {version} will be put into mods/ when the server stops, keeping the old jar as .old. {command} shows the state.
command.action.ask: Type {command} within {seconds} seconds to confirm; typing this command again replaces the pending action.
command.action.nothing: there is nothing waiting to be confirmed. Pick a mod with download or install first.
command.action.expired: that confirmation was not made within {seconds} seconds and has lapsed. Type the original command again.
command.action.other_player: that pending action was started by {player}; only they can confirm it.
command.action.stale: the report has been regenerated, so that number may no longer be the same mod; the pending action was dropped. Type the original command again, or check the numbers with {command} list.
command.help.entry_download: download the newer build of one mod (a number or a name from list)
command.help.entry_install: plan to install a downloaded mod when the server stops (a number or a name from list)
command.status.install_pending: off (but {count} authorised; installed when the server stops)
install.line: {name} {version} — the previous jar is kept as {old}
install.reason.no-hash-to-verify: the download has no recorded hash, so it cannot be verified
install.reason.hash-mismatch: the downloaded file does not match its recorded hash
install.reason.not-in-mods: that mod is no longer in the mods folder — put it back by hand if you still want it
install.reason.name-taken: a different file already holds that name
install.reason.backup-names-taken: no free '.old' name was left for the jar being replaced
install.bad_mods_folder: [Mod Update Checker] the mods folder could not be resolved, so nothing was installed: {error}
install.no_mods_folder: [Mod Update Checker] no mods folder at {directory}; nothing was installed
install.report_failed: [Mod Update Checker] the install summary could not be written: {error}
install.crashed: [Mod Update Checker] the install stage failed: {error}
install.done: [Mod Update Checker] {count} mod(s) replaced; the list is printed at the next startup.
